messages:
marta: Quick follow-up to the probation/grace RFC. I sketched a narrow ship-first change to reduce thin-client bursts without a big rollout. PTAL.
kevin: high level summary?
sam: are we keeping probation separate from normal quotas or merging?
marta: separate but lightweight: short ephemeral burst window (seconds) + fast decay. no long-lived leases.
ana: share the config sketch pls
marta: ```yaml
probation:
  window_seconds: 30
  burst_tokens: 500
  decay: linear
  fallback: degrade-to-small-model
```
jin: we should detect gaming with heuristics: repeated quick reconnects, high retry rate, low prompt success rate. flagged clients get their burst cut to 10%.
kevin: ingress interface? keep it tiny
marta: ProbationCheck(project_id, est_cost, req_id) -> {allowed_burst, probation_id|null}. synchronous, sub-ms lookups ideally.
sam: telemetry is critical. ops needs probation.granted/revoked and reasons to tune thresholds.
jin: agree. emit events: probation.granted, probation.revoked, probation.flagged.reason=<enum>. keep 7d indexed log.
ana: what if probation svc is down?
marta: fail-safe: if unreachable, no bursting. baseline quota still applies. explicit denial > safer than accidental overgrant.
sam: reuse Lease v2 APIs? don't want a brand new proto surface
marta: plan: extend Lease v2 with probation_window field. minimal footprint.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: probation-service v0.1 canary to staging (canary-3).
kevin: rollout strategy: new tenants opt-in by default, existing tenants 10% random roll, monitor abuse metrics.
jin: add SDK flag so apps can surface on_probation to developers for UX changes (shorter system prompts etc).
sam: action items: 1) marta: PR for Lease v2 proto extension. 2) jin: telemetry schema. 3) kevin: rollout + guardrails. 4) ops: chaos test for probation svc outage.
marta: timeline: protos PR today, staging tests tomorrow, feature-flag deploy next week.
kevin: also please add console doc for enterprise customers about SLA implications.
jin: will add doc blurb to docs repo.
kevin: cool. if metrics show spike in churn or fraud, we'll rollback quickly. :thumbsup:
